verdict.rationale: Motion's core product is built around AI-driven automations that run without manual intervention: it auto-reshuffles calendars, auto-prioritizes and auto-schedules tasks, converts emails/voice/meeting messages into tasks automatically, and an 'AI Workflow Builder' that builds workflows from SOPs, plus an API/Zapier layer for custom automation. Probe evidence confirms the API is live and functioning (auth-gated), supporting programmatic automation setup. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that these automations reliably run unattended in production (community evidence found only concerns backend engineering practices, not automation reliability), and more detail on how 'AI Workflow Builder' automations are configured/triggered.
